regions.text: 堅い腸爻が來てゐる個然性の解釋であるが、單に陽爻が陰の位に在るといふだけでなく三三の形象が頑覺に訴へた印象それ自身がこの解釋を是認してるる。

quote.translation: This contingency interprets the contingency of a hard yang line having come into the fourth place, and the interpretation is endorsed by the fact that a yang line stands in a yin position and also, of itself, by the impression that the figure ䷔ makes on the eye.

regions.text: 形象が頑覺に訴へた印象それ自身がこの解釋を是認

quote.translation: The hexagram Shihe places its whole weight on the contingency of the nine in the fourth place.

regions.text: 嘘嘘の卦そのものが九四の偶然性に重點の全部を置いてゐる。

quote.translation: Likewise, "Six in the fifth place: biting dried meat, one gets yellow gold" interprets the contingency that a yin line has come into the fifth place, which is a yang position and the centre of the trigram Li.

regions.text: 更に『六玉盛乾肉得黄金』も離の卦の中央である五目の陽の位へ陰爻が水た偶然性の解釋である。

quote.translation: Next, Gou, with Xun below and Qian above, has the form ䷫.

regions.text: 然性の解釋である。次に姤は巽下乾上で三

quote.translation: The Tuan zhuan says, "Gou is encounter; the yielding encounters the firm".

regions.text: 次に姤は巽下乾上で三三の形態を有つてるる。象悔に「姤遇也柔選剛也」とある。さうして「不期而會日通」であるから姤の卦では一陰が偶然にも純腸と選ふのである。

quote.translation: Since "to meet without expecting it is called encounter", in the hexagram Gou a single yin line encounters pure yang by chance, one yielding line happening upon (kaikō, 邂逅) five firm ones.

regions.text: は一陰が偶然にも純腸と選ふので

quote.translation: Gou (姤) is none other than the 逅 of Encounter, kaikō (邂逅).

regions.text: 一柔がたまたま五剛と避遍するのである。

quote.translation: The meaning of Encounter, however, is not confined to the hexagram Gou.

regions.text: 姤は遯逅の近に外ならない。

quote.translation: The Encounter of two elements is the essence of every hexagram and the foundation of the Changes as a whole.

regions.text: 然しながら選逅の意味は單にこの媚の掛だけに限られたものではない。二元の避逅は一切の卦の本質として男全般の基礎である。象傳に「天地相過品物成章也』とはその意味でなければならない。

quote.translation: This must be the sense of the Tuan zhuan's "Heaven and earth encounter each other, and all kinds of things become manifest", and the same holds for the Xici zhuan's "Heaven and earth intermingle and the ten thousand things are transformed and refined; male and female join their essences and the ten thousand things are transformed and born".

regions.text: 繫辭傳に「天地細穩萬物化醇男女構精萬物化生』といつてるるのも同様である。

quote.translation: The so-called corresponding lines (應爻) are likewise simply one manifestation of "heaven and earth encounter each other", "heaven and earth intermingle" and "male and female join their essences".

regions.text: 謂はゆる應爻の如きものも「天地相過」とか「天地細艦」とか「男女構構」とかいふことの單に一つの現はれである。

quote.translation: The contingent relation between the third line and the top line, for instance, is a correspondence of this kind.

regions.text: 例へば三爻と上爻との偶然釣開係が應爻である。

quote.translation: In the hexagram Kui we read: "Nine at the top: opposed and alone.

quote.translation: One sees a pig covered in mud, a cartload of ghosts.

regions.text: 九、瞬孤見豕負塗酸鬼一車先張

quote.translation: First one draws the bow, afterwards one unstrings it.

regions.text: 睽の卦に「上九、瞬孤見豕負塗酸鬼一車先張之弧後院之弧（限寇婚端往通雨則吉』とある。

quote.translation: No robber, a suitor for marriage.

regions.text: 寇婚端往通雨則吉』とある。

quote.translation: Going on, one meets rain, and then good fortune".
